description: Checks whether removing a load-bearing wall can stay inside the Ontario Building Code Part 9 beam tables, flags when an engineer is needed, and lists the published beam size ranges from Tables 9.23.4.2.-H to -L and 9.23.4.3.-A to -J. It is not a design. Source: 2024 Ontario Building Code (O. Reg. 163/24), Division B, Tables 9.23.4.2.-H to -L, 9.23.4.3. and 9.23.4.3.-A to -J, Articles 9.4.1.1. and 9.23.4.1., Note A-9.23.4.2.; Building Code Act, 1992, ss. 1(1) and 8(1).

city.description: Ontario city, to read the 1-in-50 year ground snow load Ss and rain load Sr from SB-1 Table 2. Leave empty and give ss_kpa and sr_kpa instead.

floor_supported_ft.description: Supported floor joist length: half the sum of the joist spans on both sides of the beam, in feet. Unit: ft.

floors_above.description: Number of floors bearing on the wall, not counting the roof.

opening_ft.description: Width of the opening the beam must cross, in feet (or use opening_m). Add opening_in for extra inches. Unit: ft.

opening_in.description: Extra inches added to opening_ft. Unit: in.

opening_m.description: Opening width in metres, instead of opening_ft. Unit: m.

point_loads.description: Does a post, a girder truss, a stair or another beam land on the beam as a point load?

roof_above.description: Does roof framing (rafters, joists or trusses) bear on this wall?

roof_supported_ft.description: Supported roof length: half the sum of rafter, joist or truss spans on both sides, in feet. Unit: ft.

sr_kpa.description: Rain load Sr from SB-1 Table 2, used when city is empty. Unit: kPa.

ss_kpa.description: Ground snow load Ss from SB-1 Table 2, used when city is empty. Unit: kPa.

trusses_bear.description: Do roof trusses bear on the wall being removed?

wall.description: Wall above the beam: exterior with brick veneer, or interior or exterior with siding (affects the steel tables only).

name: load_bearing_wall_removal_beam_sizer_guide
title: Load-Bearing Wall Removal Beam Guide
